name: Crispy Smashburger Tacos (Flour Tortilla)
whyItWorks: Pressing thin lean ground beef onto a small white flour tortilla gives crispy lacy edges with less bread bulk than a thick burger bun.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Smash a thin ball of ground beef onto a flour tortilla in a hot skillet for 2 mins, flip, top with Havarti or American cheese, and drizzle with gut-safe burger sauce (no pickle chunks).
